can target the tunnel like any remote server. The plaintext persistence is a deliber…
- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant
at the control plane and edge: the public URL stops working immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected. The server re
cord — including its now-dead `url` — is intentionally left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with the same slug.
- [List a project's plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/list-a-projects-plugins.md): The live (installed, non-u
ninstalled) Agent Plugins in the project, disabled ones included (marked `enabled: false`). Read-only: import, activation, enable/
disable and uninstall are app flows, not API operations.
- [Get a plugin version](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/get-a-plugin-version.md): One imported plugin version with
its component projections: declared MCP servers (placement, auth timing, materialized server id) and declared skills (namespaced m
odel refs). Addressed by the version id alone — access is membership of the version's own project, and historical versions of unin
stalled…
- [List a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/list-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skills visible to t
he caller in this project: the project-shared ones plus the caller's own drafts. Each row reports `pinnability`, which is what dec
ides whether its id is usable in an environment's `skillSelection`.
- [Get a skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/get-a-skill.md): One skill, including its SKILL.md body. The body is
mutable and an edit overwrites the previous one in place, so `aggregateHash` is the only handle on which content this read returne
d.
- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant tu
rn over the supplied message history and responds synchronously with the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, referenc
es to any resources it created, and any actions awaiting human approval.
- [Connect an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/connect-an-mcp-server.md): Starts a connection
request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, and validation happen asynchronously; poll the returned `connectionRequ
estId` until the status is terminal. When the next step belongs to a person, the response carries a `handoffUrl` to open.
- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current state
of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short interval is
expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here means the poll interval itself is too fast; honour Retry
-After.
- [Cancel a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/cancel-a-connection-request.md): Stops a
request and invalidates its handoff link. Cancelling an already-terminal request is a no-op.
- [Retry validation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/retry-validation.md): Re-arms a stalled validation i
mmediately instead of waiting out its backoff. Does not revive a terminal request — after `failed`, `expired`, or `cancelled`, sta
rt a new one.
- [List personas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-personas.md): The project's personas, newest first. Archived p
ersonas are excluded.
- [Create a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-persona.md): Creates one persona. To draft several with
a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` — that route persists nothing.
- [Get a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.md): A persona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answ
ers 404, never 403 — the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cannot see.
- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals still referen
ce this persona — deleting it would strand them.
- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-persona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the person
a by id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.
- [Draft personas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and p
ersists nothing. That separation is deliberate: generation is the step most likely to produce something nobody wanted, and a route
that both invented and saved would make "let me see what you'd suggest" indistinguishable from "fill my project with these".
- [Draft journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and
persists nothing — see `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.
- [Get a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)
- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-journey.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the re
sponse says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definition they executed, so their history stays readable.
- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal never disturbs a run alread
y under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.
- [List swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)
- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFA
ULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.
- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)
- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored u
nder it are not touched — they keep their own definitions and stay launchable.
- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFAULTS. Goals alread
y authored under it keep the values they were created with — this is not a cascade.
- [List journeys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goal
s are excluded.
- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a tas
k against one or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate` — that ro
ute persists nothing.
